BackstoryDef.title: thread spinner
BackstoryDef.description: Every apprentice of the Valley begins at the spinning wheel, drawing spirit thread from silk and qi until the fingers bleed and then a little longer. [PAWN_nameDef] spun for three years before being allowed to touch a puppet.

BackstoryDef.title: joint carver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carved the joints of the Valley's puppets: knees, wrists and the hundred small bones of a hand. A badly carved joint betrays its puppet in battle, and the carver's name is written inside every one.

BackstoryDef.title: valley puppeteer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a full puppeteer of the Invisible Thread, bound to puppets by threads of [PAWN_possessive] own soul. The sect teaches that a puppeteer who must step into a fight has already lost it.

BackstoryDef.title: shadow theatre player
BackstoryDef.description: Before the Convergence, [PAWN_nameDef] toured the villages with the Valley's shadow theatre, the sect's oldest disguise. Audiences saw paper heroes behind a lit screen; the puppeteers counted who watched, and who watched too closely.

BackstoryDef.title: puppet master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] masters a workshop of the Valley and drives a squad of war puppets without moving from the back line. Ling Xian, the puppet saint, taught [PAWN_objective] to fight with ten hands and think with one head.

BackstoryDef.title: breaker of machines
BackstoryDef.description: After the Iron Calamity, [PAWN_nameDef] took apart the wrecks of the machines that had burned the Valley, joint by joint, to learn how they moved. Half of today's war puppets walk the way those machines did.

BackstoryDef.title: grand puppeteer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the grand puppeteers of the Thousand Strings, second only to Gongshu Yan, who rebuilt the sect from the Calamity's scrap. [PAWN_pronoun] can hold a conversation, play a game of weiqi and drive a dozen puppets at once, and is said to lose only the conversation.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of the blueprints
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the Valley's sealed blueprints, including the copy of Yan Shi's automaton that nobody has ever managed to build. Old Kui, the previous keeper, burned the Valley's library rather than let the Calamity have it; [PAWN_nameDef] rewrote it from memory.

BackstoryDef.title: thread merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] travels with the Valley's caravans, selling thread and blueprints and buying any machine part the Rim will part with. [PAWN_pronoun] can tell a mechanoid's age from the wear of a single joint.
